name: deed_page_publisher
description: Publishes an HTML page to a live HTTPS URL at <slug>.deed.page with one HTTP PUT. No account or API key on the free plan; the returned token updates the same slug.

html.description: Full HTML document to publish as index.html (max 4 MB)

slug.description: Subdomain to publish to: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens

token.description: Token returned by the first publish of this slug; required to update it (or set DEED_PAGE_TOKEN)
